decisions.reason: Although three years of market exposure should have reduced uncertainty, this waterproof lined range still serves a clear use case and fits the firm's existing safety-footwear capabilities, so its option value likely remains slightly above its carrying cost.

This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe addresses a specific workplace requirement and is close to the firm's core offer, so keeping it is relatively low-cost and still worthwhile unless sales have clearly disappointed.

As a more generic safety shoe series in a firm with a broad portfolio, its uncertainty is likely already resolved and overlap with other lines makes resource reallocation to stronger products or new projects more attractive.
